label: Zenteiq

dataset.source: AirfRANS (Bonnet et al., NeurIPS 2022), manifest 'full' task
dataset.train: manifest full_train minus its last 80 cases (720)
dataset.nodes: every node of the internal mesh, no crop
dataset.input: 7 official node features + log10 wall distance + log10 Re

additions.features: log10(|wall distance| + 1e-6) and log10(Re), Re = U_inf / 1.56e-5
additions.targets: (Ux, Uy) / U_inf, p / U_inf^2, nut / U_inf, then normalised

metric: official Transolver Results_test: Volume / Surf = normalised MSE on non-wall / wall nodes, mean over 4 channels and 200 cases, wall Ux, Uy, nut set to 0; C_L, C_D from integrated pressure and wall shear stress; Spearman rho over the 200 cases
weights: EMA of the weights after the last epoch (nothing selected on held-out data)

paper_reference.source: Wu et al., Transolver, ICML 2024, Table 3

provenance.converted_from: AirfRANS_Results/Task04_transolver_improved/train_v2.py (run v2_500ep_highest), trained 2026-10-09/10 on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU shared with other jobs; converted to this format without retraining
provenance.note: epoch wall times include a duty-cycle throttle (GPU shared at 50 %) for part of the run
